Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs) are useful for visualizing chemical engineering processes, but making them with TikZ pictures is slow and awkward. Because TikZ and LaTeX render the diagram as a vector graphic, you can zoom in without losing image quality. This project aims to make PFDs as easy to edit as a slide.

Here are some examples of PDFs I made with the GUI. The full document is [available here](https://github.com/kylecapybara/pfdmaker/blob/main/hw7latex/hw7.pdf).
